place.name: Odeceixe
place.description: Odeceixe (European Portuguese pronunciation: [ɔðɨˈsɐjʃɨ]) is a village and civil parish in the northern part of the municipality of Aljezur, in the Portuguese Algarve, lying within the Nature Park of the Southwest Alentejo and Vincentine Coast. The village lies on the south bank of the Ribeira de Seixe, which here forms the border between the Algarve and Alentejo.
